blocks.text: Between the Minister will resign, the Minister may resign, it is likely that the Minister will resign and ... it is not excluded that the Minister resigns... there is all the difference between a news and a hypothesis. The Arabic print has a rich and precise system to scale the certainty: particles ( ⁧قَدْ⁩ , ⁧رُبَّمَا⁩ , ⁧لَعَلَّ⁩ ), expressions with ⁧مِنَ⁩ ( ⁧مِنَ المُرَجَّحِ⁩ , ⁧مِنَ المُحْتَمَلِ⁩ , ⁧مِنَ المُؤَكَّدِ⁩ ), impersonal verbs ( ⁧يُرَجَّحُ⁩ , ⁧يُعْتَقَدُ⁩ , ⁧يَبْدُو⁩ ), compulsory and waiting formulas ( ⁧يَجِبُ⁩ , ⁧يَنْبَغِي⁩ , ⁧مِنَ المُفْتَرَضِ⁩ ). In this unit you build a scale of certainty in Arabic and English, learn to distinguish the possibility from obligation and prediction, and practice not to raise or lower the degree of certainty when you translate or summarize.
